title: Smashed Cucumber Salad
description: Cucumbers smashed and tossed with garlic, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil and chili. Crunchy, tangy and ready in 15 minutes.

image.alt: A bowl of smashed cucumbers in a glossy garlic chili dressing

ingredients.item: red pepper flakes or chili crisp

steps.text: Lay the cucumbers on a board and whack them firmly along their length with the flat of a big knife or a rolling pin until they split. Cut into bite-size chunks.
Toss the cucumbers with the salt and sugar in a colander and let them drain for {time 10 min}.
Mix the garlic, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil and pepper flakes in a bowl.
Shake off the cucumber liquid, toss the cucumbers in the dressing and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve soon, while still crunchy.

notes: Smashing makes rough edges that soak up more dressing than neat slices.
